# Copilot Coding Guidelines

## Pull Request Guidelines
When generating or assisting with a Pull Request description:

- Follow the structure defined in .github/pull_request_template.md.
- Analyze the actual code changes and relevant context before generating the description.
- Focus on explaining why the change was made, not only what changed.
- Group related changes logically instead of listing modified files.
- Highlight important technical decisions and trade-offs when relevant.
- Do not invent functionality, requirements, testing results, or implementation details.
- Omit sections that are not applicable rather than adding generic content.
- Keep descriptions concise and useful for reviewers.
